capabilities: Sync training plans from a cloud-hosted XLSX or ODS workbook into generated notes
Record sets, time, rounds, and weights in the workbook and review trends and weekly reflections
Import recorded activities from Garmin Connect
Combine workbook sessions with ICS calendar feeds from Google Calendar or Nextcloud
Render workout charts locally and embed day or dashboard blocks in notes
disambiguation: Not a standalone fitness app; it renders training data from an external spreadsheet you edit into Obsidian notes and never writes back to the workbook.
extras: Desktop only (requires Obsidian 1.11.4+); mobile is not supported. Garmin integration is experimental and uses unofficial endpoints. Sync is strictly one-way (workbook → Obsidian) with no write-back. Made by Trainvent, which also offers the companion Calcrow editor and paid support/sponsorship. Development lives in a private repository.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn training plans kept in spreadsheets into linked calendars, workout logs, progress charts, and reflection notes.

relations.evidence: Based on the Obsidian sample plugin.
Garmin: connect under Connections → Garmin to import recorded activities.
Upload the completed file to Nextcloud or another service with an HTTPS download link.

requires.name: ICS calendar feed (Google Calendar, Nextcloud, or other)

summary: Training tracker that syncs an XLSX or ODS workbook into a dashboard of calendars, workout logs, and goal notes, with optional Garmin Connect import.
